title: Self-host check cost and base branch: cache projectBuild git calls; read the base branch

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
S114 later notes: projectBuild runs 1-3 git calls per project on every snapshot and status call (not measured), and the base branch is hard-coded as refs/heads/main because the registry has no base-branch field.

S109 later note (2026-10-26): at the 1 s Runs interval every Runs change makes the TUI refetch, and the daemon calls BoardRuns uncached, so a busy run may cost about one extra relay-run list per second per client (not measured).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: TestProjectBuildCachedUntilHeadMoves; TestBaseBranchFromProject (if the owner picks a base-branch source).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Measure first. Cache by the ref's mtime or the head sha. Owner to pick at preflight where the base branch comes from (the registry, slicer config, or git's default branch).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/daemon; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
